info.description: 真实RuoYi Workspace权限。captureId绑定actor+payloadHash幂等。generation拒绝删除/恢复后的迟到上传。附件不由后端联网抓取。完成时状态SAVED/PARTIAL；资源清单追加版本；导出固定创建时版本。feature默认关闭，启用需显式存储目录。fixture-origin只能为隔离环境精确loopback origin。内置TwelveMonkeys 3.13.1 WebP解码器；JPEG/PNG/WebP校验魔数、容器完整性、25MP上限，保留原图并生成320px PNG缩略图。 分区协议1：每分区身份/选择/范围与结果版本校验；来源、排除范围、有序参数与缺失确认进入只读快照。旧载荷仅兼容现有消费者并标记legacy。无SKU使用本次capture内部身份待核对，不按标题合并。概览采用同一REPEATABLE_READ读取边界，日期采用Asia/Shanghai。导出当前为同步生成，记录只有COMPLETED/UNAVAILABLE，不伪造后台队列状态。

sku.description: Missing/blank SKU creates pending internal record; never guesses SKU or merges by title

parameters.description: When extraction.parameterRows is provided, exactly the ordered non-excluded rawText rows joined by full-width semicolons. Without rawText, derive name:value and preserve unit. Each parameters block must use the same text. Excluded raw rows remain only in extraction for provenance.

images.description: For new extraction, candidates sharing a sourceId and identical URL/dimensions become one resource with all sectionIds and the first imageId. A conflicting URL/dimension or an imageId claiming another source is rejected. Legacy input keeps existing resource identities.

sku.description: Missing/blank SKU creates pending internal record; never guesses SKU or merges by title

extraction.description: Validated extraction with legacy:boolean; historical records may omit this field

rangeRevision.description: Canonical decimal string within signed int64; no JS float conversion

extractedRangeRevision.description: Canonical decimal string within signed int64; no JS float conversion

resultRevision.description: Canonical decimal string within signed int64; no JS float conversion

missingConfirmed.description: Must be true on this section when missingReason is present. A complete section cannot claim missing confirmation.

ExtractionSection.description: Same page and selection as aggregate; rangeRevision equals extractedRangeRevision, resultRevision >= 1. Empty sources require missingReason and this section's missingConfirmed:true; every missing section must be confirmed separately.

ParameterRow.description: Ordered source rows; duplicate names, rawText, unit and unknownReason are preserved. Blank name/value requires unknownReason. sourceId belongs to params section. Only non-excluded rows contribute to fields.parameters and parameters blocks; display text must agree with their rawText joined by full-width semicolons.

confirmationRevision.description: Canonical decimal string within signed int64; no JS float conversion

Extraction.description: Sections exactly match selectedSections, each identity and revision valid. Total section sources <=3000. Missing confirmation belongs to each section and is true iff that section has missingReason; there is no aggregate missingConfirmed flag. New UI requires extraction; omitted only for existing legacy consumer compatibility.
